project_info.format: 8K-style 4:5 editorial with one full-body CCTV frame and three inset crops
project_info.color_palette: sun-bleached gray plaza, white, rust red, denim black, burgundy, gold, and vivid crimson HUD overlays

main_subject.detail: cool detached adult woman with chin-length textured bob and casual bangs, thick black sunglasses, head slightly lowered, walking across a plaza while holding a drink and pastry
main_subject.wardrobe: oversized white T-shirt with rust-red raglan sleeves and small fictional chest mark, loosely tucked into baggy black carpenter jeans with white stitching, burgundy loafers, and fine gold pendant
main_subject.props: iced coffee or chocolate cup with straw in the left hand and half-eaten pastry in the right hand

composition_elements.framing: high-angle CCTV vantage with 35mm look and deep focus, full-body central frame plus face/drink, torso, and pants-cuff inset crops
composition_elements.subject_position: adult woman mid-stride across sun-bleached gray plaza tiles with long diagonal shadows cast leftward
composition_elements.overlay: crimson bounding boxes, crosshairs, scanlines, telemetry glyphs, timecode 18/02, fictional ID string CCWW | TR521, numeric stream, and abstract hashtags connected by thin red vector lines
composition_elements.layout: fragmented surveillance interface with inset crops linked to the main frame

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight at approximately 4200K with hard directional shadows
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: diagonal plaza shadows, crisp fabric weave and pavement grit, raw privacy-invasion editorial mood, subtle chromatic aberration

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 35mm lens from high CCTV angle, deep focus photorealism
technical_specs.finish: visible grain, subtle chromatic aberration, high sharpness, realistic pores and fabric texture, raw photoreal fidelity

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cyber-grunge surveillance fashion editorial in a 4:5 vertical composition: a clearly adult cool detached woman with chin-length textured bob and casual bangs, thick black sunglasses, and head slightly down walks mid-stride across sun-bleached gray plaza tiles. She wears an oversized white T-shirt with rust-red raglan sleeves and a small fictional chest mark, loosely tucked into baggy black carpenter jeans with white stitching, burgundy loafers, and a fine gold pendant. She holds an iced coffee or chocolate cup with straw in her left hand and a half-eaten pastry in her right. Shoot from a high-angle CCTV vantage with a 35mm look and deep focus, late-afternoon golden-hour light carving hard diagonal shadows leftward. Build a fragmented layout: one main full-body frame plus three inset crops of face/drink, torso, and pants cuff linked by thin red vector lines. Add vivid crimson HUD overlays with bounding boxes, crosshairs, telemetry glyphs, scanlines, timecode 18/02, fictional ID CCWW | TR521, numeric stream, and abstract hashtags. Include grain, subtle chromatic aberration, high sharpness, pavement grit, realistic pores, and raw photoreal fidelity. Keep the surveillance aesthetic fictional and non-identifying.
